$comment: GS-13: OpenF1 session 9668 (Shanghai 2024 Sprint Qualifying). PENDING: transcribed from docs/manager/F1M24-CHINA.md §2.9-2.10 (the spec's weather report read OpenF1 9668) because api.openf1.org refused every request while a live session was running (2026-11-27: 'Live F1 session in progress ... restricted to authenticated users'). Regenerate with overcut/src/main/resources/scripts/wet_session_from_openf1.py --session 9668, which writes the same keys from the raw feed. Minutes from the first rainfall row (15:52 local). airAtEndC is not in the spec: derived as the final track minus race-weather.json temperature.trackOverAirRain (the spec: 'pista - aire hacia ~5 °C'), so the cooling test checks the time constant, not the air.
